Definition: middle voice from G4253 and G1861; to promise of old:--promise before.
BiblicalUsage: Proepangellomai means to promise of old, to have promised before. Paul says the gospel was promised afore by the prophets in the holy scriptures, and again that the Corinthians' bounty was made ready beforehand.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that God never improvises, and the gospel promised long ago is the gospel preached today.
